name: Brezn
description: a crisp Nostr client from Bavaria

paragraphs: Brezn is a Nostr client that shows posts from your local area. Your position is reduced to a five-character geohash (roughly 5 × 5 km cells, depending on latitude). Only the cell is shared, never your exact coordinates. Set your feed radius by adjusting geohash query length. Each length loads that cell and its eight neighbors in one query. Like CB radio for the internet: free, equal, and decentralized.

Notes and Other Stuff Transmitted by Relays is an open, decentralized protocol for social networking. Events are stored and distributed by many independent relays. Different Nostr apps speak the same protocol and can access the same content. Your identity consists of a key pair (npub/nsec) and is not bound to a server or app. If a relay goes down, you simply use others without losing your identity or content.
